note: Data contract shared by the pipeline, the scenario engine and the web client. Every value traces to a public source listed below.

donki_sep.title: DONKI Space Weather Event API — Solar Energetic Particles
donki_sep.publisher: NASA CCMC, Goddard Space Flight Center
donki_sep.access: open, no key, CORS enabled, query window limited to 60 days

osdr_bone.title: NASA Open Science Data Repository — ALSDA bone loss studies

units.gcr_msv_day: millisievert per day, galactic cosmic radiation inside shielding
units.sep_flux_pfu: proton flux units (>10 MeV), 1 pfu = 1 particle cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1
units.sleep_h: hours slept in the last 24 h
units.bmd_pct: percent change in bone mineral density versus pre-flight baseline

tick.description: One telemetry frame. Emitted once per simulated time step by the scenario engine, forwarded verbatim by the SSE endpoint and publishable to MQTT unchanged.

fields.t_day: float, mission elapsed time in days
fields.scenario: string, id of the active scenario

alerts.source: string, citation of the threshold or the driving event
